note_en: 之所以……是因为…… states a result first and its reason second: 这道菜之所以特别，是因为它的鸭皮又薄又脆 "The reason this dish is special is that its skin is thin and crispy." English usually puts "because" first or says "the reason... is that...", but Chinese prefers this result-then-cause order when explaining why something is the way it is.
